repairs.disposition: Evidence-scope correction to analyst countermodel; do not upgrade a boundary test to full-stack observation.

range: Named boundary tests include pre-write rejection and a later SQL failure; browser record separately includes two post-commit variants. Not an independent fresh holdout.
limits: Original red evidence is boundary-level; do not claim this bug was first discovered by the E2E oracle.
Aggregate browser witness does not preserve each failing/repair trace; no new browser run performed.
Later oracle repairs remain separate; historical green is not a current whole-framework certificate.
abstraction: Evidence-work process; application execution is an observed check result, not simulated database behavior.
event_wording: Action granularity and short names are analyst choices; observations retain source references.
state_semantics: Guards are AND clauses, with OR across clauses. A replay event has enabled, occurring and accomplished-but-not-depleted phases. Phase expansion is a modeling convention, not measured timing. Repeated checks are new occurrences; evidence is reusable, not consumed by being read.

commutation_checks.basis: C-R4; provisional source-derived independence, not a real-world scheduling experiment
